description: Returns the authenticated user's current clock-in status — whether they are currently clocked in, and when. Use when the user asks 'am I clocked in?', 'what is my clock status?', 'am I working right now?'. Do NOT use for historical data — use list_my_timesheet for that. Faster and cheaper than get_dashboard_summary when only clock status is needed.
name: get_clock_status

clock_in_time.description: ISO 8601 clock-in timestamp if clocked in, null otherwise

is_clocked_in.description: Whether the user is currently clocked in

title: Clock Status
